description: This file defines a custom implementation of complex numbers (`c10::complex`) for use in PyTorch, supporting multiple device types and including operator overloads, conversions, and literals. It aims to unify complex number operations across different internal representations and hardware backends.

classes.name: complex
classes.description: A templated class implementing complex numbers supporting various device types and conversions, with operator overloads and literals.

classes.name: complex<Half>
classes.description: Specialization of complex for Half-precision floating point, with limited support.
